rationale: Calculated using steady-state heat balance model: R_hot at T_max=75C, convection with wind speed^0.6, radiation using Stefan-Boltzmann law, and solar gain. Ampacity = sqrt((convection + radiation - solar_gain) / R_hot). Minimum ampacity occurs at t01 (highest ambient, lowest wind, highest solar). Scheduled current 520A exceeds rating only at t01.
